description: Generate API integration tests (supertest, httpx or REST Assured) asserting status, response body (partial match) and auth; optional validation, security-header and rate-limit checks

appPath.description: supertest: module exporting the Express/Koa app (default ../src/app)

auth.description: Endpoint requires a bearer token (adds a 401-without-token test)

baseUrl.description: httpx / REST Assured: base URL (default http://localhost:3000; BASE_URL env overrides)

expectedBody.description: Subset the response body must contain, e.g. {"status": "ok"}

name: generate_api_integration_test
